lists.title: High Frequency Words 1
lists.description: List 1 of the High Frequency Words series (v1.2): the 250 most frequent words from CYP-LEX (1,200 UK children's books), after dropping proper nouns, the 250 most common words, rare/name-like forms, plain inflections, and merging American spellings into their British/Australian equivalent before ranking — ranked most frequent first.
